_comment: ASSUMED schema. No live packet capture of the article-list endpoint was available at implementation time (issue #96). The request URL/params and this response shape are modelled after the sibling menu/joined-cafes REST endpoints and Naver Cafe's public article-list API conventions. Verify against a real capture before treating as confirmed.
